QuestInfo.name: Those Obnoxious Starfish
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1092002##k is too busy to sit down and eat, so he scarfs down his lunch box in a moment. Maybe he could use a hand.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1092002##k is listening to Nautilus to make sure she's running okay. However, he can't hear anything over the noisy #r#o1220000#es#k. Don't let those #o1220000#es get in your crew mate's way! Take them out!
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the #r#o1220000#es#k. Maybe #b#p1092002##k can concentrate on his work.

0.0: Speaking of... Argh, they're so LOUD!\r\nSorry, not you! Ugh, it's a long, stupid story...\r\n
0.1: I'm listenin' in on the sea under the Nautilus. But I can't hear a danged thing over all those dratted #r#o1220000##k up on the beach!
0.2: Somebody needs to take care of those dang #r#o1220000##k, I tell ya...\r\nHey, you got a weapon! Want to get rid of them Starfish for me?

yes.0: #r#o1220000##k breed so fast it's like they appear from nothing. But if you can just shut 'em up for a second or two, that'd be good enough. Maybe take out #b30#k #r#o1220000##k.

no.0: Yeah, yeah, I know. Everybody got their own problems...

1.0: Good news! There's a big ol' shock wave heading our way!\r\nOkay, maybe that ain't great news, but I wouldn't've been able to hear it if you hadn't shut up those Starfish.

yes.0: Don't worry, this ol' beauty can take a shock wave or two as long as we're ready. Thanks. Ya might've just saved the Nautilus.

mob.0: Nah, it's okay, matey. Not everyone can take on #b30#k #r#o1220000##k. You can give up if you like.
